subject.title: feat(ios): og:image thumbnails on link preview cards

question: Should this PR intentionally support single-frame GIF thumbnails in the hardened link-preview image fetcher, or should image mode stay limited to JPEG/PNG/WebP as the PR's safety contract says?
rationale: The extra GIF decoder surface affects remote untrusted content handling, and automation should not decide whether that security boundary is intended.

options.title: Keep the declared allowlist
options.body: Remove GIF support from the image MIME allowlist and decoder path so implementation, tests, and PR safety rationale stay aligned.

options.title: Approve GIF support
options.body: Keep GIF only with maintainer-visible policy approval plus tests and real behavior proof for the added format.

recommendation.title: Keep the declared allowlist
recommendation.body: Remove GIF support from the image MIME allowlist and decoder path so implementation, tests, and PR safety rationale stay aligned.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the linked mobile polish follow-up and authored the prior iOS link-preview feature surface.
